design: Fit token-balanced output PCA on item0-3 in each wording. Compare one joint rankB basis to two separate rankB/2 bases, B=8/16/32/64. Joint fit gives equal total training weight to each wording. Evaluate items4-7 separately in each wording; both wording families now represented in fitting. Include single-wording rank32 transfer diagnostics and random64. No downstream objective fitting.
scope: Equal stored vector count, not equal active rank: joint usesB per token, conditional usesB/2 plus known wording label. No learned router, target-free coefficients or unique semantic coordinates. Adaptive familiar panel; evaluation item IDs excluded from both fits.
